resources.string: Handspell is designed to practise with your hand, not collect it.
Your camera frames are processed on this phone to detect your handshape. They are never recorded, saved or uploaded.
Handspell has no account, analytics SDK or crash reporter. Practice content and handshape references are bundled with the app.
If purchases are added, the Test Store checks an entitlement through RevenueCat. Camera frames and hand landmarks never leave your device.
Debug build only. Records landmark rows while held; never use a real name as the signer ID.
